description_expanded: Dune It Up - Luxury 30A Vacation Rental in Dune Allen Beach with Beachviews Favorite Features: - Gigantic Resort-Style Pool - Less Than 20 Yards from Public Beach Access - Game Room - Huge Rooftop Deck - Ocean Views More About Dune It Up: Located directly on County Hwy 30A, less than 20 yards away from the Dune Allen Beach public beach access, you'll find one of the largest and most luxurious homes on the Emerald Coast. Dune It Up features state-of-the-art amenities, breathtaking views, and masterful design. This three-story vacation home has everything you need for your next beach getaway. In fact, it even has one of the best private pools you'll find on all of 30A. Its massive resort-style pool features sunk-in bench seating, a gigantic spa tub, and a swim-up cabana. Dune It Up also features a game room, gourmet kitchen, media room, spectacular gulf views, and a rooftop deck! The first floor of this luxurious three-story home features an entertainment area complete with a pool table and a wet bar seating up to five people. From the game room, guests can walk out onto the pool deck where there’s plenty of seating, two al fresco dining tables each seating four, an outdoor kitchen, elevated entertainment area, and a large private pool complete with a spill-over hot tub. The backyard is the perfect place to entertain whether you’re hosting an event or simply having a family barbecue. In addition, the first floor also features two guest bedrooms, one with a queen bed and the other a king. Both bedrooms feature flat-screen TVs and ensuite bathrooms with walk-in showers. To get to the second floor, guests can either take the stairs or their own private in-home elevator up to the main living space. The second floor boasts spectacular gulf views, lake views, a gourmet kitchen, formal dining area, and spacious living room. In addition, the second floor also features two gigantic balconies, one of them with amazing views of the Gulf of Mexico. Between the gigantic kitchen featuring a massive texturized quartz island seating six, the two formal dining tables each seating eight, Dune It Up is the perfect place to host a big family event since there’s plenty of dining space. The dining area and kitchen also both overlook the pool and Gulf of Mexico and lead out to the balcony. Furthermore, Dune It Up also includes an open and airy living room that also boasts gulf views. The living room even features two sleeper sofas and also has balcony access. In addition to the kitchen, dining area, and living room, Dune It Up also has two guest bedrooms on the second floor.  The third bedroom features a king bed, twin/twin bunk beds, and an ensuite bathroom with a walk-in shower. The fourth bedroom also features a king bed and an ensuite bathroom with a walk-in shower. Both bedrooms have their own flatscreen TVs. The third floor hosts the remaining sleeping accommodations for guests in the media room, bunk nook, and four additional bedrooms. There are also two more balconies on the third floor. The media room has sleeper sofas and a flatscreen TV. Down the hall, the bunk nook accommodates four more guests in two sets of twin/twin bunk beds, each bed with its own flatscreen TV. The remaining four bedrooms all have king beds, flatscreen TVs, gulf views, and ensuite bathrooms. Two of the ensuite bathrooms even have stand-alone bathtubs in addition to walk-in showers! In addition to all the amazing amenities at Dune It Up, this luxurious home even features a rooftop deck that overlooks the Gulf of Mexico. All in all, sleeping thirty guests, with a private pool, spa tub, game room, and more, Dune It Up is the ultimate 30A vacation home! Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 2: Queen Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. SECOND FLOOR Bedroom 3: King Bed, Twin over Twin Bunk & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 4: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. THIRD FLOOR Bedroom 5: King Bed with Shared Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub.  Bedroom 6: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 7: King Bed with Shared Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 8: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub. Bedroom 9: 2 Twin over Twin Bunks.
